evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 月地云居
evidence.excerpt_zh: 山髙水長之北度橋由山口入梵刹一區為月地雲居殿五楹前殿方式四面各五楹後樓上下各七楹月地雲居之東為法源樓又東為静室西度橋折而北為劉猛將軍廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按月地雲居四十景之一額為皇上御書山門額曰清浄地前殿額曰妙證無聲後樓簷額曰蓮花法藏與法源樓静室諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 山高水長, through a gap in the hills: a Buddhist precinct, 月地雲居, with a five-bay hall, a square front hall of five bays per side and a seven-bay two-storey rear tower. 法源樓 and a 静室 to the east, 劉猛將軍廟 to the north-west.

evidence.title: Scene 16, 月地云居 Yuedi Yunju
evidence.excerpt_other: It had a wall around the courtyard, central and side gates, drum tower, and bell tower in the center, a large square building with eight columns on each side and a double roof, two pavilions covering stone tablets, and at the rear a two-story building, possibly a library of Buddhist scriptures, and several other buildings.
evidence.summary: A temple to the Buddha of Three Worlds, with a smaller temple just east. Layout from n.37, read from the picture and the plan. Through the pines one saw the round fort and the far hills.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
